title: How It Works
desc: 3 easy steps to unify and streamline customer interactions throughout your sales process.

actions.title: Add Sales Actions
actions.desc: Create an Action Panel for your team on our web portal, by choosing from existing Sales Actions or customize your own.

actions.title: Interact With Customer
actions.desc: Text/email Sales Actions to customers from your CRM & from our Mobile App. Customers can easily review and submit info right from their mobile device.

actions.title: Complete the Sale
actions.desc: Automatically import everything directly into your CRM and other existing platforms. Close the deal & Onboard clients without any heavy lifting.
